capabilities: Capture daily notes in a continuous journal with date ranges, sorting, and presets
Read and edit several connected pages together in a Page Stream of embedded editors
Configure a navigation panel with journal folders, note links, and website shortcuts
Browse grouped bookmarks and filter recent files and tasks
Navigate headings and nested lists with depth folding in an enhanced outline
disambiguation: Not a semantic ontology or knowledge-graph tool; the name refers to a workspace layout for journals, page streams, and navigation.
extras: Source-available license: commercial use requires PkuLilLBoat's prior written permission. Formerly named Roam Workspace (plugin ID remains roam-workspace). The manifest claims mobile support and Obsidian 1.8.7+, but the README says this has not been independently validated and recommends starting in a test vault.
intentEvidence: If you work with Logseq, Roam Research, Orca Note, or SiYuan, Ontology Workspace brings a familiar way of working
problem: Obsidian lacks Roam- and Logseq-style workflows such as a continuous journal and a stream that keeps several linked pages open and editable side by side.

relations.evidence: Ontology Workspace works with Metadata Menu in the Navigation panel
Scoped Outliner integration supports list editing
separately retained third-party components, including Hover Editor, Outliner, and dependencies
the earlier base implementation was subsequently fully rewritten

summary: Roam-style workspace plugin that adds a continuous journal, a side-by-side page stream, configurable navigation, grouped bookmarks, and nested-list outline navigation.
